scope: Initial 27 combat obligations and 3 stat-generation obligations, not an exhaustive catalogue of League behavior. Partial model support remains in the denominator. Older builds are historical. Candidate labels never imply admission.

agreement.note: No independent-trial confidence inferred from correlated replay hits.

attack-context.note: Provisional action associations and client stat continuity; no semantic blocker or admission credit.

diagnostics.note: Latest conditional study, not additive reruns and not admitted evidence.

slices.note: Observed champion counts do not establish champion-wide verification. Item/rune slices await sufficient reconstructed context.
